senses.en: the group of elected representatives that makes a country's laws

ex.en: The new law must be approved by parliament before it takes effect.
ex.zh: 新法必須經國會通過才會生效。

root.note: 談話、議事的地方 → 議會

senses.en: a shop providing a particular service or product
(old-fashioned) a sitting room in a private house

ex.en: We celebrated her birthday at an ice cream parlor.
ex.zh: 我們在一家冰淇淋店為她慶生。

senses.en: an imitation of a style or work that exaggerates it for comic effect
to imitate in an exaggerated, humorous way

ex.en: The comedy show performed a parody of a famous cooking program.
ex.zh: 喜劇節目模仿惡搞了一個知名烹飪節目。

parts.m: beside, against 旁邊、對著（= para-）

root.note: 唱對台的歌 → 諷刺性模仿

senses.en: (of words) derived from the same root; similar in sound or form

ex.en: "Wise" and "wisdom" are paronymous words from the same root.
ex.zh: wise 和 wisdom 是同源的字。

root.note: 名字在旁邊的 → 同源的

senses.en: a sudden, violent attack of emotion or activity
a sudden recurrence of a disease's symptoms

ex.en: The joke sent the audience into a paroxysm of laughter.
ex.zh: 那個笑話讓觀眾爆出一陣狂笑。

root.note: 尖銳到極點 → 突然發作

senses.en: the killing of one's parent or close relative; a person who does this

ex.en: The Greek tragedy tells the story of a prince accused of parricide.
ex.zh: 這部希臘悲劇講述一位被控弒親的王子的故事。

senses.en: to analyze a sentence into its parts and describe their grammatical roles
to examine or analyze something closely

ex.en: Lawyers will parse every word of the contract.
ex.zh: 律師會逐字仔細分析合約。

senses.en: able to be divided, especially of inherited property

ex.en: Under the old law, the land was partible among all the sons.
ex.zh: 依舊法，土地可以分給所有兒子。

senses.en: a person who takes part in something

ex.en: Each participant in the study was paid twenty dollars.
ex.zh: 這項研究的每位參與者都獲得二十美元。

root.note: 拿走一部分的人 → 參與者

senses.en: to take part in an activity or event

ex.en: All students are encouraged to participate in the discussion.
ex.zh: 鼓勵所有學生參與討論。

senses.en: strongly supporting one party or cause, often without fairness
a strong supporter of a party or cause
a member of an armed group fighting secretly against an occupying force

ex.en: The debate over the budget became bitterly partisan.
ex.zh: 預算的辯論變成了激烈的黨派之爭。

root.note: 屬於某一派的人 → 黨派的

senses.en: a light wall that divides a room
the division of a country into separate parts
to divide into parts

ex.en: A glass partition separates the kitchen from the dining area.
ex.zh: 一道玻璃隔間把廚房和用餐區隔開。

root.note: 分成部分 → 分割、隔板

senses.en: (theology) capable of feeling or suffering
senses.zh: （神學）能感受痛苦的；有感受力的

ex.en: Theologians have long debated whether God is passible.
ex.zh: 神學家長期辯論上帝是否能感受痛苦。

parts.m: suffer, feel 受苦、感受（= path）

mn: 別和 passable（可通行的；還過得去的）搞混。

senses.en: accepting what happens without active response or resistance
(grammar) in the passive voice

ex.en: Watching TV is a passive activity compared with playing sports.
ex.zh: 和運動相比，看電視是一種被動的活動。

senses.en: relating to the peaceful countryside or shepherds
relating to the spiritual care given by a priest or teacher
senses.zh: 牧師的；（對學生、信眾的）輔導的

ex.en: The painting shows a pastoral scene of sheep grazing by a stream.
ex.zh: 這幅畫描繪羊群在溪邊吃草的田園景色。

root.note: 牧羊人的 → 田園的；牧師的

senses.en: relating to a father; fatherly
related through the father

ex.en: My paternal grandparents live in the south of Taiwan.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母（父親那邊）住在台灣南部。

senses.en: the state of being a father
authorship or origin

ex.en: He took two weeks of paternity leave after his daughter was born.
ex.zh: 女兒出生後，他請了兩週的陪產假。

senses.en: a quality that arouses pity or sadness

ex.en: The film's ending is full of pathos, and many viewers cried.
ex.zh: 電影結局充滿悲情，許多觀眾都哭了。

root.note: 引起受苦的感覺 → 悲情

mn: 修辭三要素：ethos（人格）、pathos（情感）、logos（邏輯）。

senses.en: the male head of a family or tribe
a senior bishop in some Christian churches

ex.en: The family patriarch gathered everyone for the New Year dinner.
ex.zh: 一家之長召集所有人吃年夜飯。

root.note: 父親作為統治者 → 族長

senses.en: a member of the noble class in ancient Rome; an aristocrat
aristocratic; refined

ex.en: She spoke with a patrician accent that revealed her wealthy upbringing.
ex.zh: 她說話帶著上流社會的口音，透露出優渥的成長背景。

root.note: 古羅馬「元老（父老）」的後代 → 貴族

senses.en: property inherited from one's father or ancestors
heritage or tradition

ex.en: He wasted his entire patrimony on gambling.
ex.zh: 他把祖產全都賭光了。

root.note: 父親留下來的東西 → 祖產

senses.en: love for and loyalty to one's country

ex.en: The soldiers' patriotism inspired the whole nation.
ex.zh: 士兵們的愛國情操激勵了全國。

senses.en: to treat someone as if they are less intelligent or important
senses.zh: 以高人一等的態度對待；瞧不起

senses.en: to be a regular customer of a store or business
to support an artist or cause financially

ex.en: Please don't patronize me; I understand the problem perfectly well.
ex.zh: 請別把我當小孩看，我完全了解這個問題。

parts.m: protector 保護者（源自 pater 父親）

root.note: 像父親般照顧 → 贊助；居高臨下 → 瞧不起

senses.en: a name derived from the name of one's father or ancestor

ex.en: In Iceland, a person's last name is usually a patronymic, such as Jónsson.
ex.zh: 在冰島，人的姓通常源自父名，例如 Jónsson。

senses.en: a series of quick, light tapping sounds
rapid, smooth talk used by a salesperson or performer
to make quick, light tapping sounds

ex.en: I fell asleep listening to the patter of rain on the roof.
ex.zh: 我聽著雨滴在屋頂上啪嗒作響而睡著。

senses.en: a very small amount of something; scarcity

ex.en: The paucity of evidence made it impossible to convict him.
ex.zh: 證據不足，無法將他定罪。

senses.en: a very poor person

ex.en: The rich merchant lost everything and died a pauper.
ex.zh: 那位富商失去一切，最後窮困而死。

mn: 馬克吐溫的小說《The Prince and the Pauper》即《乞丐王子》。

senses.en: the state of being extremely poor, especially needing public aid

ex.en: Nineteenth-century reformers tried to reduce pauperism in the cities.
ex.zh: 十九世紀的改革者試圖減少城市中的赤貧現象。

senses.en: a building or large tent used for an exhibition or event
a light, open building in a park or garden

ex.en: Each country built its own pavilion at the World Expo.
ex.zh: 每個國家都在世界博覽會上建造了自己的展館。

senses.en: a person to whom money is paid

ex.en: Write the payee's name clearly on the check.
ex.zh: 請在支票上清楚寫上收款人的姓名。

root.note: 被付款的人 → 收款人

senses.en: inclined to avoid conflict; peaceful
senses.zh: 愛好和平的；溫和的；和平的

ex.en: The protesters held a peaceable march through the city.
ex.zh: 抗議者在市區進行了一場和平遊行。

senses.en: free from disturbance; calm
not involving war or violence

ex.en: We spent a peaceful afternoon reading by the lake.
ex.zh: 我們在湖邊看書，度過一個寧靜的午後。

senses.en: capable of sinning or making mistakes

ex.en: Even the wisest leader is peccable and needs honest advisers.
ex.zh: 即使是最睿智的領袖也會犯錯，需要誠實的顧問。

mn: 反義詞 impeccable（無瑕的）更常見。

senses.en: a small, unimportant sin or fault

ex.en: Being late once is a peccadillo, not a reason to fire someone.
ex.zh: 遲到一次只是小過失，不足以開除一個人。

senses.en: guilty of wrongdoing; sinful

ex.en: The peccant clerk confessed to stealing from the register.
ex.zh: 那名犯錯的店員承認從收銀機偷錢。

senses.en: relating to the chest
a chest muscle (usually plural)

ex.en: Push-ups strengthen the pectoral muscles.
ex.zh: 伏地挺身可以鍛鍊胸肌。

senses.en: relating to money

ex.en: He helped the charity without any pecuniary reward.
ex.zh: 他幫助那個慈善機構，不求任何金錢報酬。

root.note: 牲畜是古代的財產 → 金錢的

senses.en: the science or art of teaching

ex.en: The course in pedagogics prepares students to become teachers.
ex.zh: 教育學課程培養學生成為教師。

root.note: 引導兒童的學問 → 教育學

senses.en: a teacher, especially a strict or pedantic one
senses.zh: 教師；（尤指）古板嚴厲的老師

ex.en: The old pedagogue corrected every tiny mistake in our essays.
ex.zh: 那位古板的老教師會糾正我們作文裡的每一個小錯誤。

root.note: 古希臘帶孩子上學的奴隸 → 教師

senses.en: the method and practice of teaching

ex.en: Modern pedagogy emphasizes active learning over memorization.
ex.zh: 現代教學法強調主動學習，而非死背。

senses.en: a lever operated by the foot
to move by pushing pedals, as on a bicycle

ex.en: She had to pedal hard to get up the steep hill.
ex.zh: 她必須用力踩踏板才能騎上陡坡。

root.note: 用腳踩的東西 → 踏板

mn: pedal（踏板）和 peddle（兜售）發音相同。

senses.en: a person overly concerned with minor details or rules, or with showing off learning
senses.zh: 賣弄學問的人；書呆子；吹毛求疵的人

ex.en: Only a pedant would complain about a missing comma in a text message.
ex.zh: 只有吹毛求疵的人才會抱怨簡訊裡少了一個逗號。

root.note: 原指教師 → 賣弄學問的人

senses.en: to sell goods by going from place to place
to promote an idea or view persistently

ex.en: Some websites peddle false health claims to sell products.
ex.zh: 有些網站散布不實的健康宣稱來賣產品。

senses.en: a person who travels around selling small goods
a person who sells illegal drugs

ex.en: A peddler sold toys and snacks outside the temple.
ex.zh: 一個小販在廟外賣玩具和零食。

senses.en: the base on which a statue or column stands
a position of great admiration

ex.en: The bronze statue stands on a marble pedestal.
ex.zh: 那座銅像立在大理石底座上。

mn: put someone on a pedestal：把某人捧得很高、過度崇拜。

senses.en: a person walking rather than driving
dull and ordinary; lacking imagination

ex.en: The critic called the novel's plot pedestrian and predictable.
ex.zh: 評論家說這本小說的情節平淡無奇、毫無新意。

root.note: 用腳走的 → 行人；步行般緩慢無趣 → 平凡的

senses.en: the branch of medicine dealing with children

ex.en: She chose pediatrics because she loves working with children.
ex.zh: 她選擇小兒科，因為她喜歡和孩子相處。

root.note: 治療兒童的學問 → 小兒科

senses.en: the record of an animal's ancestry; a person's family background
(of an animal) purebred

ex.en: The breeder showed us the puppy's pedigree.
ex.zh: 繁殖業者給我們看小狗的血統證明。

root.note: 族譜的分支線條像鶴腳 → 血統

senses.en: the nobility as a whole; the rank of a noble

ex.en: The scientist was raised to the peerage for his contributions.
ex.zh: 那位科學家因其貢獻而被封為貴族。

senses.en: better than all others; unequaled

ex.en: The chef's peerless skill earned her three stars.
ex.zh: 那位主廚無與倫比的手藝為她贏得三顆星。

root.note: 沒有同等對手 → 無雙的

senses.en: easily irritated, especially by small things

ex.en: The tired child grew peevish and started to whine.
ex.zh: 那個疲倦的孩子變得煩躁，開始哭鬧。

mn: pet peeve（最討厭的小事）的 peeve 和 peevish 同源。

senses.en: transparently clear
easy to understand

ex.en: Her pellucid prose makes difficult science easy to follow.
ex.zh: 她清晰的文筆讓艱深的科學變得容易理解。

root.note: 光能穿透的 → 清澈的

senses.en: a punishment for breaking a law or rule
a disadvantage suffered as a result of an action
(sports) a penalty kick or shot

ex.en: The penalty for littering is a fine of three thousand dollars.
ex.zh: 亂丟垃圾的處罰是罰款三千元。

senses.en: an act of self-punishment to show sorrow for wrongdoing

ex.en: As penance for forgetting her birthday, he cooked dinner all week.
ex.zh: 為了彌補忘記她生日，他煮了一整個星期的晚餐。

root.note: 悔恨而自我懲罰 → 贖罪

senses.en: a strong liking or tendency

ex.en: My sister has a penchant for spicy food.
ex.zh: 我妹妹特別愛吃辣。

parts.m: lean, hang 傾斜、懸掛（法文 pencher）

senses.en: a piece of jewelry that hangs from a chain around the neck

ex.en: She wore a silver pendant shaped like a crescent moon.
ex.zh: 她戴著一個新月形的銀墜子。

senses.en: hanging down loosely; drooping

ex.en: The willow's pendulous branches touched the surface of the pond.
ex.zh: 柳樹下垂的枝條碰到了池塘水面。

senses.en: a weight hung from a fixed point that swings back and forth
the tendency of opinion to swing between extremes

ex.en: The pendulum of the old clock swung slowly back and forth.
ex.zh: 老時鐘的鐘擺緩緩地來回擺動。

root.note: 懸掛擺動的東西 → 鐘擺

senses.en: able to be entered or passed through; understandable

ex.en: The jungle was barely penetrable without a machete.
ex.zh: 沒有砍刀幾乎無法穿越那片叢林。

root.note: 可以進入的 → 可穿透的

senses.en: to go into or through something
to understand something difficult
to succeed in entering a market or organization

ex.en: Sunlight cannot penetrate the thick forest canopy.
ex.zh: 陽光無法穿透濃密的樹冠。

senses.en: the act of entering or passing through
the ability to understand clearly; insight
the extent to which a product is used in a market

ex.en: Smartphone penetration in Taiwan is among the highest in the world.
ex.zh: 台灣的智慧型手機普及率名列世界前茅。

root.note: 進入內部 → 穿透、洞察

senses.en: relating to or shaped like a peninsula

ex.en: The peninsular region is surrounded by water on three sides.
ex.zh: 這個半島地區三面環水。

root.note: 幾乎是島的 → 半島的

mn: peninsula 是名詞「半島」，peninsular 是形容詞。

senses.en: sorrow and regret for having done wrong

ex.en: The boy showed real penitence after breaking the window.
ex.zh: 打破窗戶後，那男孩真心表示悔過。

senses.en: relating to or expressing penitence or penance

ex.en: The monks walked barefoot on a penitential pilgrimage.
ex.zh: 修士們赤腳踏上贖罪的朝聖之旅。

senses.en: a long, narrow triangular flag
a flag awarded to a sports champion; the championship itself

ex.en: A school pennant hung above his desk.
ex.zh: 他書桌上方掛著一面學校三角旗。

senses.en: regular payments made to a retired person
[pɑnˋsjɔn] a small guesthouse in Europe

ex.en: My grandfather lives on his government pension.
ex.zh: 我祖父靠政府發的退休金過活。

senses.en: a group or set of five; a period of five years or days

ex.en: Weather data were averaged over each pentad of five days.
ex.zh: 氣象資料以每五天為一組取平均值。

senses.en: a shape with five sides and five angles
(the Pentagon) the headquarters of the US Department of Defense

ex.en: The children cut a pentagon out of colored paper.
ex.zh: 孩子們用色紙剪出一個五邊形。

senses.en: a five-pointed star drawn with five straight lines

ex.en: The magician drew a pentagram on the floor with chalk.
ex.zh: 魔術師用粉筆在地上畫了一個五芒星。

senses.en: a solid figure with five faces

ex.en: A pyramid with a square base is a pentahedron.
ex.zh: 底面為正方形的角錐是一種五面體。

senses.en: a line of verse with five metrical feet

ex.en: Shakespeare wrote most of his plays in iambic pentameter.
ex.zh: 莎士比亞的劇作大多以抑揚五步格寫成。

senses.en: an athletic contest consisting of five different events

ex.en: The modern pentathlon includes fencing, swimming, and horse riding.
ex.zh: 現代五項包括擊劍、游泳和馬術。

senses.en: (chemistry) having a valence of five

ex.en: Phosphorus can form pentavalent compounds.
ex.zh: 磷可以形成五價化合物。

senses.en: second to last

ex.en: The penultimate chapter reveals who the thief really is.
ex.zh: 倒數第二章揭露了小偷的真正身分。

root.note: 幾乎是最後的 → 倒數第二的

mn: 常被誤用為「終極的」，其實是「倒數第二」。

senses.en: extremely poor
unwilling to spend money; stingy

ex.en: The penurious old man reused the same tea bag for a week.
ex.zh: 那個吝嗇的老人一個茶包泡了一整個星期。

root.note: 缺乏的 → 赤貧的；小氣的

senses.en: extreme poverty

ex.en: The famous painter lived in penury and sold few works during his life.
ex.zh: 那位知名畫家生前一貧如洗，作品賣出的很少。

senses.en: to walk or travel through or around a place, often slowly

ex.en: On Sundays, we like to perambulate through the old town.
ex.zh: 星期天我們喜歡在老城區漫步。

mn: 英式 pram（嬰兒車）就是 perambulator 的縮寫。

senses.en: to notice or become aware of through the senses
to understand or regard in a particular way

ex.en: Many people perceive the city as expensive but exciting.
ex.zh: 許多人認為這座城市物價高但很有活力。

senses.en: able to be seen or noticed, often only slightly

ex.en: There was a barely perceptible change in the color of the sky.
ex.zh: 天空的顏色有幾乎察覺不到的變化。

root.note: 可以抓到的 → 可察覺的

senses.en: the way something is understood or regarded
the ability to notice things through the senses; insight

ex.en: The ad campaign changed public perception of the brand.
ex.zh: 這波廣告活動改變了大眾對該品牌的觀感。

root.note: 完全掌握 → 知覺、看法

senses.en: the quality of noticing and understanding things well; perceptiveness

ex.en: The detective's percipience helped him spot the tiny clue.
ex.zh: 偵探的敏銳洞察力讓他發現了那條細微線索。

root.note: 完全掌握的能力 → 洞察力

senses.en: quick to notice and understand; perceptive
senses.zh: 感知敏銳的；有洞察力的

ex.en: A percipient reader will notice the hidden symbolism in the poem.
ex.zh: 敏銳的讀者會注意到這首詩中隱藏的象徵。

root.note: 能完全掌握的 → 敏銳的

senses.en: (of a liquid) to filter slowly through a porous material
(of ideas) to spread gradually

ex.en: Rainwater will percolate through the soil into the ground water.
ex.zh: 雨水會滲過土壤進入地下水。

senses.en: a coffee pot in which boiling water repeatedly passes through the grounds

ex.en: Grandpa still makes coffee in an old metal percolator.
ex.zh: 爺爺至今仍用一個老舊的金屬滲濾壺煮咖啡。

root.note: 讓水滲過咖啡粉的器具

senses.en: musical instruments played by striking, such as drums
the striking of one object against another

ex.en: He plays percussion in the school orchestra.
ex.zh: 他在學校管弦樂團負責打擊樂器。

senses.en: insisting on immediate obedience; rudely commanding
(law) final; not open to appeal

ex.en: The manager's peremptory tone upset the whole team.
ex.zh: 經理不容分說的語氣讓整個團隊很不高興。

root.note: 完全拿走、不留餘地 → 不容分說的

senses.en: lasting for a very long time or happening again and again
(of a plant) living for several years
a plant that lives for several years

ex.en: Traffic jams are a perennial problem in this city.
ex.zh: 塞車是這座城市長久以來的問題。

root.note: 貫穿整年、年年都有 → 長久的

senses.en: capable of becoming perfect or improved

ex.en: The philosopher believed that human society is perfectible through education.
ex.zh: 那位哲學家相信人類社會能透過教育臻於完美。

root.note: 可以做到完全的 → 可臻完美的

senses.en: deliberate betrayal of trust; treachery

ex.en: The general's perfidy led to the fall of the city.
ex.zh: 那名將軍的背叛導致城池失守。

senses.en: to make a hole or holes through something

ex.en: A sharp nail can perforate a bicycle tire.
ex.zh: 尖銳的釘子可能刺穿腳踏車輪胎。

senses.en: to carry out a task or action
to entertain an audience by acting, singing, or playing

ex.en: The band will perform live on Saturday night.
ex.zh: 樂團將在星期六晚上現場演出。

root.note: 完全做好 → 執行、表演

senses.en: the making of perfumes; a shop selling perfumes

ex.en: The town of Grasse in France is famous for its perfumery.
ex.zh: 法國格拉斯鎮以香水製造聞名。

root.note: 透過煙霧散發香氣 → 香水製造

senses.en: done quickly and without real interest or care

ex.en: The guard gave my bag only a perfunctory glance.
ex.zh: 警衛只是敷衍地瞄了我的包包一眼。

root.note: 只求把事做完 → 敷衍的

senses.en: used to show uncertainty; possibly

ex.en: Perhaps we should leave early to avoid the traffic.
ex.zh: 或許我們應該早點出發避開車潮。

senses.en: the point in an orbit where the moon or a satellite is closest to Earth

ex.en: A supermoon occurs when a full moon is near its perigee.
ex.zh: 滿月接近近地點時就會出現超級月亮。

senses.en: the tendency to recur at regular intervals

ex.en: Scientists studied the periodicity of the comet's appearances.
ex.zh: 科學家研究那顆彗星出現的週期性。

root.note: 繞一圈的路程 → 週期 → 週期性

senses.en: traveling from place to place, especially for work

ex.en: As a peripatetic music teacher, she visits five schools each week.
ex.zh: 身為巡迴音樂老師，她每週要跑五所學校。

root.note: 四處走動的；亞里斯多德邊散步邊講學 → 逍遙學派

senses.en: (perjure oneself) to lie deliberately in court after swearing to tell the truth

ex.en: The witness refused to perjure herself to protect her boss.
ex.zh: 那名證人拒絕為了保護老闆而作偽證。

senses.en: the crime of lying in court after promising to tell the truth

ex.en: He was charged with perjury after lying to the jury.
ex.zh: 他因對陪審團說謊而被控偽證罪。

senses.en: the state of lasting forever or for a long time

ex.en: Tattoos have a permanence that some people later regret.
ex.zh: 刺青是永久的，有些人事後會後悔。
